item.tib: stag la thugs sgrub bcud dril bkra shis gter rdzong gi las byang chen mo
item.coloph: de nas stag la thugs kyi sgrub pa las / bkra shis gter gyi rdzong zhes bya ba 'di/ lho nub dpal gyi ri bo nas/ yum chen thugs rje byams ma yis/ kho bo 'phags btsun pad ma rjer/ zab mo bka' yi dngos grub thob/ phyi rabs grogs po yongs kyis bskul/ 'gro la phan phyir bka' rgya khrol/ legs pa'i bka' chab yi ger bkod/ nyes pa dkyil 'khor tshogs la mthol/ legs pa'i dge ba
